affectedPaths: docs/云端迁移常见错误清单.md

businessDifference.summary: 无已批准业务差异；恢复战斗中暂停热恢复只维护自动战斗并等待 Runner 脱战、脱战后再读取 fresh Dialog/Tracker 的权威规则。

connectivity.producer: Client WindowObservationRunner 每次 start 重武装 startup combat duty；WindowObservationSampler 发布 exact run/window/HWND 的 VISIBLE/ABSENT 事实与 IN_COMBAT/COMBAT_EXITED Runner 边沿。
connectivity.transport: CloudFastExpectedCombatExitCoordinator 只投影 Runner 边沿到 scoped GameContext，并发布 COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED ready event。
connectivity.consumer: CloudTurnTaskRuntime 的通用 PAUSE_RESUME 门在任何 GameTask.execute、启动补给、G017 Title/Dialog ACK 或 phase 决定前消费首个 Runner 战斗状态；战中只运行 AutoCombatService maintenance tick 并 park。
connectivity.ordering: Runner 首个明确 combat snapshot -> 通用 startup gate -> VISIBLE 时 auto-combat maintenance/park -> Runner fresh ABSENT exit frame -> next accepted observation -> task-specific startup recovery

proves: startup combat gate precedes visible startup maintenance and G017 consumption
combat wait uses Runner COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED and existing auto-combat maintenance
Cloud radar does not participate in startup phase adjudication

connectivity.producer: Runner publishes NOT_IN_COMBAT and the post-exit observation cycle produces a new G017 Title/Dialog pair under a rearmed interest revision.
connectivity.transport: Cloud ready-event state carries NOT_IN_COMBAT; CloudWindowObservationInbox fences Title/Dialog by exact observation run, HWND, observer sequence and current interest revision.
connectivity.consumer: TiantingTask removes combat-era G017 interests, rearms after exit, rejects the stale pair and only then maps fresh title present to RUN_SUBTASKS or fresh absent to ACCEPT_TASK.
connectivity.ordering: NOT_IN_COMBAT -> remove combat-era interests -> rearm revision -> fresh paired Title/Dialog -> G017 ACK -> phase

proves: combat-era title absent cannot be consumed after exit
post-exit interest rearm occurs before G017 phase consumption
fresh title present continues RUN_SUBTASKS instead of navigating to ACCEPT_TASK
